valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 20 Nov 2026. (1) Business: a group. Weighted by H1 FY2027 segment operating profit of the profitable segments (Interim Sep 2026, p. 8): property 48% (Marina Square flats Rs 3.25bn, offices and warehouses Rs 1.30bn), construction 26% (civil engineering, construction materials, mechanical: Rs 2.47bn), vehicles 25% (Rs 2.36bn), renewable energy 2% (Rs 0.22bn); radiopharmaceuticals (a small loss) left out. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) could NOT be opened: his site is blocked by this run's network settings. Stand-ins from web-search extracts: Engineering/Construction global unlevered, cash-corrected 0.76 (date not shown; his US figure for January 2026 is 1.14); Real Estate (Development) US, January 2026, 0.56 (as used for Prime Lands), also used for the rental property because no Real Estate (Operations) figure could be read; Auto & Truck global, January 2026, 1.15 (a manufacturer figure; Sathosa and Access Motors are distributors, so probably on the high side); Green & Renewable Energy global 0.57. Weighted: 0.76. (3) Relevered with net debt Rs 39.52bn (30 Sep 2026, incl. leases, less cash and deposits) ÷ market value Rs 83.30bn (1,000mn shares at Rs 83.30, CSE close 20 Nov 2026) = 0.47, at 30% tax: 0.76 × (1 + 0.70 × 0.47) = 1.01. (4) No local 5-year beta could be found by web search (none of the usual pages was reachable). (5) So 1.01 is used. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7) Cost of equity from scripts/reinvestment.py. (8) Shown in the Required return tile. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with the emerging-markets file and local betas.

valuationInputs.name: Maintenance capex basis
valuationInputs.reason: The company gives no maintenance/growth split. 2025/26 capex booked Rs 3.24bn included Rs 1.89bn for the FDG radiopharmaceutical plant (a named growth project); the rest (about Rs 1.35bn) is close to depreciation (Rs 1.26bn).

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: Adjusted NAV, justified price to book, residual income (weighted); P/E and whole-company DCF as cross-checks
valuationInputs.reason: Marina Square is a one-off development whose remaining profit can't sit in a P/E multiple or a steady-growth DCF, so the weighted methods all start from book value plus the Marina Square profit still to come. The P/E (normal EPS × justified P/E + Marina Square) gives about the same as price to book, and the DCF is swamped by Marina Square stock swings and investment property under construction.

valuationInputs.name: Marina Square value
valuationInputs.reason: Flats left at cost about Rs 28.7bn (Rs 34.43bn at March 2026 less about Rs 5.7bn of cost released with Rs 8.99bn of H1 sales: own estimate; the reports don't say how many units are unsold). Profit after allocated finance cost 20% / 30% / 34% of sales (H1 2026/27: 31%); tax 15% / 0 / 0 (BOI tax holiday, end date not stated); discounted 0.70 / 0.78 / 0.85 for 4 / 3 / 2 years of sales.

valuationInputs.name: Adjusted book
valuationInputs.reason: NAV Rs 46.70 (30 Sep 2026) plus the base-case Marina Square value Rs 9.59. Used as book for price to book and residual income.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE
valuationInputs.reason: Recurring EPS about Rs 5.1 a year (2025/26 without the revaluation gain; H1 2026/27 without Marina Square and the tax credit, ×2) is 9% of adjusted book. Debt repaid from Marina Square cash, rent from the Marina Square commercial space (Rs 9.3bn at cost) and the FDG plant should lift it toward 12%; 15% only in the bull case with a construction recovery.

valuationInputs.name: Long-term growth
valuationInputs.reason: Roughly nominal GDP growth; below the 12.24% bond yield and WACC.

valuationInputs.name: Adjusted NAV multiple
valuationInputs.reason: Conglomerate discount in the bear case; investment property is at fair value, so 1.0x in the base case.

valuationInputs.name: Normal EPS (P/E cross-check)
valuationInputs.reason: Recurring EPS about Rs 5.1 over the last 12 months (without Marina Square, revaluation gains and the Access Medical Tracers tax credit). Far below the reported run-rate (12 months Rs 10.42; Sep quarter × 4 Rs 16.32) because those include one-offs.

valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: scripts/reinvestment.py, 20 Nov 2026: 8.24% + 1.01 × (4.2% + 6.08%), ±1.5 points. Was 18 / 16.5 / 15% typed by hand.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: scripts/reinvestment.py, 20 Nov 2026: cost of debt 8.1% (interest paid ÷ average borrowings and leases, 2025/26), tax 32.9%, debt weight 32.2% (net debt Rs 39.52bn, market cap Rs 83.3bn). Used only in the DCF cross-check.

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 3% / 6% / 9%; supported 18.4% reported, about 3% on ordinary capex
valuationInputs.reason: The calculator's 18.4% (reinvestment rate 176% × return on capital 10.5%, 2025/26) is inflated by the Rs 5.97bn working capital build (Marina Square flats) and the Rs 4.08bn Harbour Village buyout, neither repeatable. On capex alone (Rs 3.24bn booked less Rs 1.26bn depreciation = 29% of after-tax operating profit) × 10.5% it is about 3%. Base 6% is 3 points above that: the FDG plant is built, the Marina Square commercial space is nearly finished and vehicle imports have reopened. Bull 9% needs a construction recovery. Growth only enters the P/E and DCF cross-checks.

openQuestions: How many Marina Square flats are still unsold, and at what prices and margins? (No unit figures in the reports; the Rs 28.7bn of cost left is an own estimate.)
Does net debt (Rs 39.5bn at Sep 2026) fall as buyers pay the balance of their flats, or is the cash used for new projects?
When does Harbour Village's BOI tax holiday end?
Marina Square commercial space: completion, leasing, and any revaluation gain (Rs 9.3bn at cost).
Construction: new contracts and order book; civil engineering profit fell to Rs 0.25bn in H1.
Vehicle sales after the first rush of imports; any change to import rules.
PAYE tax case (Rs 635mn + Rs 317mn penalties) at the Supreme Court; recovery of about Rs 1.45bn from the ended logistics-hub project.
Refresh the beta in January 2027 with Damodaran's emerging-markets file and local 5-year betas.

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/redo AEL.N0000 full). Rebuilt from the downloaded annual report 2025/26 and the interims to June and September 2026. Added reinvestment figures, required return from beta (1.01, provisional; cost of equity 18.6% instead of 16.5% by hand), management and shareholder sections. Methods now adjusted NAV, justified price to book and residual income, each with the Marina Square profit still to come (P/E and DCF as unweighted cross-checks). H1 EPS Rs 5.79 is mostly Marina Square and a one-time tax credit; recurring EPS about Rs 5.1. Unit sales at Marina Square aren't disclosed, so the remaining cost (Rs 28.7bn) is an own estimate; no local beta could be found. Category 3 unchanged.
